steps.step: start: production as it is today (previous API release on schema 98, API as gps-api, PDF processor as its own service) with a grant issued by that release
the migration cannot take its lock -> nothing is changed, the attempt is set aside
new API does not become healthy -> automatic return: previous binary, schema 98, web link as before
new API healthy but the processor service fails its check -> automatic return
apply: schema 99, new API healthy, web switched; the processor service was not touched or restarted; the earlier grant still downloads
rollback: previous binary and web, schema 98 with both rules as before; the earlier grant still downloads; check passes again
apply again; the production smoke script completes against the rehearsal host (later revision, run from its own directory)
going back is refused once a grant uses the new section
repair forward: another build that knows schema 99 replaces the API file and serves; schema, grants, web and the processor service stay
the previous binary does not start on schema 99: going back by the binary alone is not an option
log: migration 99 was previously applied but is missing in the resolved migrations

steps.step: the released binary is put back and serves again; everything else is as it was after the smoke
